title: Revival among India's youth
summary: India is ~1/5 of world population; youth (15-29) ~27.2% (~38 crore). Pray they accept Jesus Christ as Savior.

title: Suicide prevention
summary: ~8 lakh suicide deaths/yr globally, most among 15-44 (129 aged <29, 119 aged 30-44, 94 aged 45+). Family conflict, debt, disease, unemployment, exams cited.

title: Road accidents (bike)
summary: 45 children die daily in road accidents; ~1.98 lakh children/youth (2011-2022), 14-17 deaths doubled. Pray for road safety compliance.

title: LGBTQ+ community
summary: Yogyakarta markers rose from 3.5% (2012) to 18.8% avg in Gen Z and 22.7% lately. Pray against deception, exploitation, coercion.

title: Alcohol & substance addiction
summary: ~14.6% (~16 crore) of Indians consume alcohol; 8.5 lakh+ alcoholics. Youth exposure highest.

title: Violence against girls & women
summary: UNICEF: 370+ crore girls/women, 1 in 8 experience rape/sexual violence before 18 (data affects living today). POCSO cases rose 3407 to 5319 (+56%) 2023-2024.

title: Cinema / entertainment addiction
summary: Fans pouring alcohol on actors; OTT content with explicit/sensual content destroying many. Pray for turning back.

title: Pornography & masturbation
summary: India is 3rd largest consumer of porn after USA/UK; significant smartphone users involved. Praising mental damage, self-esteem, relationships/marriage.

title: Rising occult crimes
summary: POCSO-type cases +56% (3407 -> 5319, 2023-2024); many children killed or sexually abused.

title: Live-in relationships & rising divorces
summary: Pre-marital cohabitation growing among youth, seen as trial/prelude to marriage; pray youth escape fornication.

title: Digital & social media addictions
summary: Internet/social media addiction growing, esp. among teens/college students, harming mental health & academics. Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat, WhatsApp, dating apps.

title: Generation Z / Zoomers salvation
summary: Born mid-1990s to early 2010s. Challenges: short attention span, tech dependence, academic/peer pressure, lack of loyalty, no obedience to parents. Pray they enter salvation and become young revivalists.
